$comment: Guides removed from the corpus because they carry no Fallout 76 information: pages about the source websites themselves (site-meta, site-qa, user-post, donation, merchandise), navigation pages (navigation-shell, listing-shell, category-blurb) and pages about other games, the TV series or real life (not-fallout-76). Reviewed by hand on 2026-09-22. scripts/truth/clean-wiki-corpus.ts drops these ids from the index and deletes their bodies on every run, so a re-import cannot bring them back; src/lib/wiki/guides-excluded.test.ts pins that.

reasons.site-qa: a Q&A page about the website
reasons.user-post: a member's forum post on the site, not an article
reasons.site-meta: about the website, its team, features, subscriptions or community
reasons.category-blurb: a blog category landing page: a description of the category and a list of post titles
reasons.navigation-shell: the scraped body is only the site menu or a list of links
reasons.listing-shell: a blog category listing of post titles and dates; the posts themselves are separate guides
reasons.not-fallout-76: about another game, the TV series or real life
reasons.empty-after-cleaning: Nothing left after removing site boilerplate: the original content was screenshots or site chrome that was never captured, so the page shows only a title and a link.
